# California Courts Self-Help Guide

> > Official self-help resource from California Courts providing legal guidance, forms, and procedures for family law, restraining orders, child support, evictions, and court access services.

This site serves Californians navigating the court system without attorneys, offering step-by-step instructions in multiple languages. Managed by the Judicial Council of California, it covers family law matters, restraining orders, child support through the Local Child Support Agency (LCSA), and language access services including court interpreter complaints.

## Key Topics

- Family Law
- Child Support & LCSA
- Restraining Orders
- Court Forms (Judicial Council forms)
- Legal Service of Process (Entrega Legal)
- Court Interpreters & Language Access
- Child Support Commissioner Hearings
- Meet and Confer Requirements
- Elder and Dependent Adult Abuse
- Eviction and Mediation
- Divorce Procedures
- Name Change and Gender Recognition
- Supervised Visitation
- Remote Hearings
- Autoayuda Legal (Spanish Self-Help)

## Family Law & Child Support

- [Child support](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/child-support): Child support basics, calculator, LCSA services, court orders
- [What to expect at hearing with the Local Child Support Agency](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/request-for-order/LCSA/hearing): Guide to LCSA child support hearings, meet and confer requirements
- [Professional Providers to supervise visits](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/guide-supervised-visitation/professional-provider): Info on professional supervised visitation providers, training, fees
- [Cómo finalizar su divorcio si su cónyuge no presentó una respuesta](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/es/divorcio/iniciar-divorcio/conyuge-no-presento-respuesta): Spanish guide: Complete divorce when spouse doesn't file response
- [Audiencia judicial para cambiar el nombre y reconocer el género del menor](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/es/audiencia-judicial-para-cambiar-el-nombre-y-reconocer-el-genero-del-menor): Spanish guide: Minor name change and gender recognition court hearings

## Restraining Orders & Protection

- [Elder and Dependent Adult Abuse](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/EA-restraining-order/forms): Forms and resources for elder/dependent adult abuse restraining orders
- [Prepárese para la audiencia de la corte por su orden de restricción](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/es/preparese-para-la-audiencia-de-la-corte-por-su-orden-de-restriccion): Spanish guide: Prepare for restraining order court hearing

## Court Forms & Legal Procedures

- [Guía sobre los formularios de la corte](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/es/conceptos-basicos/encuentre-formularios): Spanish guide: Understanding and finding California court forms
- [Busque a alguien a quien le debe hacer una entrega legal](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/es/entrega-legal-como-encontrar-a-alguien): Spanish guide: How to locate someone for legal service of process
- [Mediation in eviction cases](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/eviction-mediation): Eviction mediation process for landlord-tenant dispute resolution

## Language Access & Interpreter Services

- [Recursos en español](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/es/language-resources-spanish): Spanish language resources: interpreters, forms, remote hearings
- [Court Interpreters Complaints - Russian](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/court-interpreters-complaints-russian): Russian language: File complaints about court interpreter services
- [Language Access Complaints - Farsi](https://selfhelp.courts.ca.gov/fa/language-access-complaints-farsi): Farsi language: File complaints about court interpreter services
